q5_source_check.source: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level Syllabus v4.0.1, released 2024-09-15, §5.1.1 printed p.48; official PDF https://istqb.org/?download_id=3345&sdm_process_download=1
q5_source_check.availability: Opened directly; text for printed p.48 accessible and personally checked.
q5_source_check.verified: A test plan describes test objectives, resources and processes for a test project; documents means/schedule, helps ensure activities meet criteria, communicates with stakeholders, and demonstrates adherence to existing test policy/strategy or explains deviation. Typical contents include context/scope/objectives, assumptions/constraints, stakeholders, communication, risk register, test approach (including levels/types/techniques/deliverables/criteria/metrics/data/environment and deviations), budget and schedule.
q5_source_check.implication: This directly confirms that test plans can contain the approach and relate explicitly to strategy. It supports the Q5 theory caveat that the boundary and physical document structure are contextual; it does not prescribe one universal stand-alone Test Strategy Document template or imply strategy equals a test plan.

phase_a_reconciliation_correction.prior_phase_b_wording: Phase A did not contain separate completeness assessments for Q5.
phase_a_reconciliation_correction.correction: That wording was inaccurate. phase-a-notes.raw.json does include Q5 option_coverage entries for A/B/C/D, including explicit claims that B/C/D do not cover strategy purpose or rationale. These were reviewer completeness judgments, though not separately labeled with a fullness field.
phase_a_reconciliation_correction.whether_revised: Yes. In Q5 Phase B, I re-evaluated the same visible options after disclosure and separated structural answer completeness from truth. I retained A as key but revised the completeness judgment: B, C, and D each give a definition plus a sufficiently described content/purpose for their own erroneous model; they are complete wrong answers, even though the model is false. Thus the raw Phase A records remain unchanged, while the later judgment is explicitly a reassessment, not a claim that Phase A lacked coverage notes.

limitations: This supplement addresses only Q5 source linkage and the Phase A record; it does not reopen option review.
The original Phase A and Phase B files were not modified.
